title: Mini-surge rollback preview canvas
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: During staged rollouts and canaries, on-call engineers need a fast, low-friction way to assess surge signals and execute a minimal rollback or traffic-sculpt action without leaving the main traffic dashboard. Current rollouts UI requires a multi-step flow and deep navigation to perform an emergency mitigation. Goal: Design a compact, in-context 'mini-surge rollback preview canvas' that surfaces the minimal controls and signal context needed for quick mitigation: live traffic split, key KPIs (latency P95, errors, cost delta), recent commit/variant info, and one-click rollback or temporary throttles. The canvas should be embeddable in the rollout timeline and the traffic inspector panel, and should support keyboard shortcuts for rapid response.
acceptance_criteria: Mini-canvas prototype (Figma) shows live traffic split, top 3 signals, current commit/variant, and two primary actions: 'Pause new traffic' and 'Revert to previous variant'
Canvas fits within 390x220px area and remains readable at 90% zoom on desktop
Usability test (5 on-call engineers) average task completion <= 45s for initiating rollback
Design tokens and component variants defined and handed off to Engineering with accessibility color contrast checked
Edge cases: when previous variant is unavailable, canvas shows safe fallback with recommended steps and 'Open full rollback flow' link
decisions: Prioritize two-call primary actions (pause / revert). Full sequence orchestration remains in full rollback flow to avoid accidental complex state changes.
Surface only top 3 signals by relevance algorithm (latency, error-rate, token-cost delta) to reduce cognitive load.
Keyboard shortcut assigned: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R opens the canvas when focus is on rollout timeline.
Canvas is read-only for viewers without 'deployment.control' permission; action buttons are disabled with tooltip explaining required role.
tradeoffs: Compact canvas limits room for exploratory diagnostics; we prioritize speed over depth and link to the full inspection panel for advanced triage.
One-click revert will trigger server-side safety checks; this adds 1-3s latency before rollback — acceptable vs. UX simplicity.
Embedding canvas increases bundle size slightly; we'll lazy-load canvas assets only when timeline is visible to mitigate impact.
notes: Prototype uses synthetic live data; integration with metrics API required for production variables (ENG-22380).
Design should reuse tokens from console-2025.09 theme; avoid creating new color variables unless necessary for signal highlights.
We defined microcopy for risk states: 'degraded', 'surge', 'stable' — consult PM for exact thresholds.
